Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle, along with Leo Gordon, Joan Shawlee, Don Kennedy, Kenneth MacDoNald, Patrick Waltz, and Ken Chryson. First aired in 1954.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.sub-title: S02 : E15 Bloodline
programme.desc: After shooting Luke Grayson in self-defense, Ben Cartwright must protect himself from Graysons son, Todd, who seeks to avenge his fathers death.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.sub-title: S01 : E21 Spanish Grant, The
programme.desc: The Cartwrights try to invalidate a Spanish land grant to stop the De La Cuesta family from taking part of the Ponderosa and all of the Carson Valley settlers' land.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.sub-title: S01 : E22 Blood on the Land
programme.desc: Adam Cartwright finds himself hostage to Jeb, a dangerous sheep herder who wants Ben to sign over a large plot of land.Starring Michael Landon as Little Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.sub-title: S01 : E25 Escape to Ponderosa
programme.desc: Ben helps three deserters, escaped from an Army stockade. Learning what they had to deal with, Ben promises to share the truth with his friend who is in charge of the fort.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Home in Oklahoma
programme.desc: The entire gang is here! Roy Rogers, Dale Evans, Gabby Hayes, and Trigger are all involved in a murder mystery involving the death of a wealthy ranch owner. Songs include I Wish I Was A Kid Again and Cowboy Ham and Eggs.

programme.title: In Old Cheyenne
programme.desc: Roy Rogers plays a newspaper reporter sent to Cheyenne to investigate a reputed troublemaker. While on the scene, he discovers who the real bad guys are, and sets out to right some wrongs. Also starring Roy's usual sidekick George 'Gabby' Hayes, plus Joan Woodbury, and George Rosener. This Republic Pictures western was helmed by director Joseph Kane (The Undersea Kingdom, Dakota) and features two musical numbers: 'Bonita' and 'Linda Flor'.

programme.title: Kentucky Rifle
programme.desc: His Wits, Weapons and Women, Turned Defeat Into Victory! A man brings a wagonload of Kentucky rifles through Indian Territory. Unfortunately the Indians realize what he has and offer the travelers an ultimatum: the rifles or their lives! Starring Lance Fuller, Sterling Holloway, Henry Hull, Chill Wills, Cathy Downs, and Jeanne Cagney, plus one of the great B-Western heels, I. Stanford Jolley!

programme.title: Buffalo Stampede
programme.desc: A big time cast, including Randolph Scott, Buster Crabbe, Barton MacLane, and Harry Carey star in this feature about stampedes, Indian attacks, and plundering thieves! Directed by the esteemed Henry Hathaway (True Grit, Niagara).

programme.title: Way of the West
programme.desc: Government agent Gordon (Hal Taliaferro) goes undercover to investigate an ongoing war between cattlemen and sheepmen. But he soon finds himself framed for murder! This low budget western from the short-lived Empire Pictures is from the golden era of shoot em ups, when audiences knew who the bad guys were, and couldnt wait for the good guys to serve up some just punishment!

programme.title: The Trail Beyond
programme.desc: Rod Drew (John Wayne) is in search of a missing miner and his daughter in this Lone Star Picture. Along the way, Drew rescues his pal Wabbi (Noah Beery Jr.) from card cheats who have framed him for murder. You'll find plenty of action and suspense in this vintage horse opera, originally distributed by the kings of the B western, Monogram Pictures!

programme.title: The Outlaw
programme.desc: Billy the Kid, Pat Garrett, and Doc Holliday ride again in Howard Hughes' epic 1943 western, but the character you'll remember most is sultry country vixen Rio McDonald. Hughes' nationwide search for an actress to play Rio resulted in the film debut of Jane Russell, whose natural assets were allegedly helped by a special bra designed by Hughes. When The Outlaw finally received a nationwide release in 1946, its success vindicated Hughes and made Russell a star. As for Hughes' infamous bra, Russell said in her 1988 memoir, I never wore it, and he never knew.

programme.title: Santa Fe Trail
programme.desc: Oscar winner Michael Curtiz (Casablanca, Mildred Pierce) directed this exciting drama about Army officer Jeb Stuart and the days leading up to the Civil War. Errol Flynn (The Adventures of Robin Hood) stars as Stuart, with Olivia de Havilland as his romantic interest (the seventh of nine times they were paired together by Warner Bros.) The cast includes Ronald Reagan as General George Custer, and Raymond Massey as John Brown, with such familiar faces as Alan Hale and Van Hefflin in supporting roles. Filmed partly in Santa Fe!

programme.title: The Gunman from Bodie
programme.desc: The Rough Riders, a popular group that thrilled audiences in the early 1940s, are after a gang of rustlers in this B-western from Hollywood's Poverty Row. Starring Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, and Raymond Hatton, this movie features everything from lawmen going undercover to the Rough Riders looking after an orphaned baby! Also, be on the lookout for the beautiful Christine McIntyre, who would go on to appear in several of the Three Stooges shorts for Colombia Pictures.

programme.title: Born to Battle
programme.desc: Cyclone Tom Saunders starts a ruckus in a Chinese laundry and has to go before a judge. Unable to pay his fine, he is bailed out by a local cattle rancher and agrees to do 30 days' work for him. It's not too long before he becomes enmeshed in a war between rustlers and outlaws.

programme.title: Brothers of the West
programme.desc: Tom Tyler plays Tom Wade, a range detective whose brother has been accused of robbery and murder. Wade has only one clue to prove his brothers innocence: a set of unusual tire tracks. This film was directed by Sam Katzman, who later became known as Jungle Sam for his association with a variety of jungle thrillers, and then as a master of all exploitation genres, from teen horror to flying saucer flicks!

programme.title: Hellgate (Edited Version)
programme.desc: In 1867 Kansas, veterinarian Sterling Hayden treats an injured stranger who turns out to have been a guerrilla raider--and Hayden soon finds himself serving a term in one of the world's most terrifying prisons under sadistic commandant Ward Bond. Adapted from the story of Dr. Mudd, the physician who attended John Wilkes Booth, assassin of President Lincoln.

programme.title: Grand Canyon Trail
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures feature about the hunt for silver in a deserted ghost town. Songs include 'Colorado Joe' and 'Everything's Going My Way'. Plus, look for Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher. Film buffs should look for silent screen foil James Finlayson, a familiar face from various Keystone Cop comedies, as the local sheriff.

programme.title: Colorado
programme.desc: Theres trouble out west! Its the Civil War and the Union needs troops back east to defend itself. Roy Rogers stars as Lieutenant Jerry Burke, who is sent to investigate why the returning troops are being stalled in Colorado. Also starring Gabby Hayes, Pauline Moore, and Milburn Stone, this film is action packed with a turn you wont see coming!

programme.title: Cowboy And The Prizefighter
programme.desc: Red Ryder takes Steve Stevenson, who has saved his life, to his ranch and gives him a job. Red's aunt, the Duchess, knew Steve's father, who supposedly committed suicide after losing his ranch betting on a prizefight. Steve refuses to believe that his father took his own life, suspecting he was murdered. Red and Little Beaver aid Steve in finding his father killer.

programme.title: Northwest Trail
programme.desc: Mountie Matt OBrien assignment is simple: He is to escort the rather grouchy, and slightly annoying, Miss Katherine Owens to a remote outpost. Things complicate however when they arrive at the outpost and he stumbles upon an illegal mining operation. Stars include Bob Steele, Joan Woodbury, and Poodles Hanneford.

programme.title: Hoppy Serves a Writ
programme.desc: Sheriff Hopalong Cassidy triumphs again in this lighthearted western romp from Harry Sherman Productions. Good ol' Hoppy (William Boyd) has to leave his beloved Texas to track down some bad guys in Oklahoma. You can bet that the action and suspense will follow Hopalong wherever he goes. Also, look for a number of familiar faces in the ast, including TV's future Superman George Reeves, notorious Hollywood heavy Victor Jory, and in his first credited role, Robert Mitchum! In fact, Mitchum would appear in more of Hoppy's adventures before branching out on his own and becoming one of Hollywood's greatest stars. Also featuring Jan Christy, Forbes Murray, Byron Foulger, Earle Hodgins, and Roy Barcroft. Directed by Goerge Archainbaud.

programme.title: Range War
programme.desc: William Boyd returns in the 25th of 66 Hopalong Cassidy adventures. This time Hopalong goes undercover to expose a group of ranchers who are interfering with the building of a new railroad. Also, look for Russell Hayden as Lucky Jenkins, and Britt Wood as Speedy McGinnis. It's a great, action-packed adventure from director Leslie Selander (Flight to Mars, Riders of the Range), and further proof that no one pushes Hoppy around and gets away with it!

programme.title: Heat - Gorączka
programme.desc: Neil McCauley (Robert De Niro), złodziej wysokiej rangi, wzbił się na szczyt kariery dzięki inteligencji, czujności oraz byciu nieuchwytnym. Detektyw Vince Hanna (Al Pacino) jest niezawodny w swoim fachu i tym razem wziął na swój cel McCauleya.

programme.title: Psycho Trip
programme.desc: Spence Cutler (Andrew Jenkins) jest psychopatą, któremu obce są empatia czy poczucie winy. Jego los odmienia się jednak po kontakcie z nowym narkotykiem, który dostarcza mu potężną dawkę rzeczywistości i zabiera go w psychodeliczną podróż autostradą własnej świadomości.

programme.title: Marmaduke - pies na fali
programme.desc: Ekranizacja sławnej, długo nadawanego komiksu o wielkim psie o imieniu Marmaduke

programme.title: JFK
programme.desc: Prokurator okręgowy w Nowym Orleanie, Jim Garrison, przejmuje śledztwo w sprawie zabójstwa prezydenta Johna F. Kennedy'ego w Dallas, w Teksasie, w 1963 roku. Poznaje fakty, które budzą w nim podejrzenie, że sprawa jest znacznie bardziej złożona, niż to, o czym się dowiaduje opinia publiczna.

programme.title: Zbrodnia namiętności
programme.desc: Znudzony życiem Connor zmienia się po wejściu w związek z uwodzicielską i piękną Marylin.

programme.title: 360. Połączeni
programme.desc: Decyzja przystojnego biznesmena, który zdoła oprzeć się pokusie i pozostanie wierny swojej żonie, wywoła serię nieoczekiwanych zdarzeń.

programme.title: Taśmy Watykanu
programme.desc: 27-letnia Angela Holme w zagadkowy sposób sprowadza cierpienie i śmierć na każdego, kto znajdzie się w jej pobliżu. Miejscowy ksiądz, ojciec Lozano zaczyna badać jej przypadek i dochodzi do wniosku, że kobieta padła ofiarą opętania.

programme.title: Sex Doll
programme.desc: Ekskluzywna prostytutka wdaje się w niebezpieczny romans z tajemniczym mężczyzną.

programme.title: Natural Born Killers
programme.desc: Perypetie Mickey’a i Mallory: wyrzutków, kochanków i seryjnych morderców. Podróżując trasą 666, dopuszczają się psychodelicznych w swej aurze morderstw nie dla pieniędzy ani z zemsty, lecz by przeżyć dreszczyk emocji.

programme.title: Pracownik miesiąca
programme.desc: Spokojny urzędnik zostaje przeniesiony na Grenlandię. Czy będzie to dla niego początek nowej, wspaniałej kariery?

programme.title: Matka Teresa i Ja
programme.desc: Kavita, mieszkująca we współczesnym, tętniącym życiem Londynie, staje w obliczu miłosnych i rodzinnych trudności. W poszukiwaniu odpowiedzi na wiele nurtujących ją pytań, udaje się do indyjskiej wioski, gdzie spędziła dzieciństwo.

programme.title: Godzina prawdy
programme.desc: Dziewczyna znika z rodzinnego wypadu na kemping a policja nie jest w stanie podjąć żadnego tropu. Rodzice zaginionej rozpoczynają poszukiwania na własną rękę.

programme.title: Helen nie żyje
programme.desc: Po niefortunnym porzuceniu przez chłopaka Addie konfrontuje się z nim na przyjęciu, podczas którego odkryty zostaje trup.

programme.title: Nieprawdopodobna
programme.desc: Melissa puka do drzwi Nicka, by powiedzieć mu, że nosi dziecko jego brata, któru zginął w wypadku pięć lat wcześniej.

programme.title: Bunkier
programme.desc: Uwięziona w bunkrze grupa żołnierzy powoli zwraca się przeciwko sobie. Gdy paranoja i strach narastają, mężczyźni doświadczają prawdziwego piekła wojny.

programme.title: Shutter - Widmo
programme.desc: Młode małżeństwo odkrywa niepokojące, upiorne ślady na zdjęciach wywołanych po dziwacznym wypadku, podczas którego – jak sądzą – potrącili samochodem młodą dziewczynę.

programme.title: Odrodzony. Charles Manson
programme.desc: Tianna pragnie stworzyć taśmę do przesłuchania filmowego. Zabiera wiec swojego chłopaka na pustynię, by uchwycić idealne tło, jednak mroczne wydarzenia z nagrania zaczynają przenikać do rzeczywistości.

programme.title: Marmaduke - pies na fali
programme.desc: Ekranizacja sławnej, długo nadawanego komiksu o wielkim psie o imieniu Marmaduke

programme.title: The Brave
programme.desc: W albańskim mieście znanym z produkcji narkotyków i handlu elitarną grupą gliniarzy określonymi do końca wojny prowadzonej przeciwko lokalnej policji...

programme.title: 4:44 Ostatni Dzień na Ziemi
programme.desc: Dwoje kochanków spędza swoje ostatnie chwile w apartamencie na Manhattanie.

programme.title: Dawno temu w Ameryce
programme.desc: Pełen przemocy i pasji film gangsterski o losach czterech przyjaciół z dzieciństwa, które spędzili w dawnej żydowskiej dzielnicy Nowego Jorku. Jako dorośli zostali znanymi gangsterami, współtworzącymi przestępcze imperium ery prohibicji.

programme.title: Żegnajcie, Głupcy
programme.desc: Kiedy 43-letnia Suze Trappet otrzymuje śmiertelną diagnozę, postanawia odnaleźć swoje dziecko, które zmuszona była opuścić jako nastolatka.
